start.title: Marcharse
start.text:
[TODO:es] You and your friend leave the city.
Hope has died on a Roman cross.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Despair is not the last word.

argue_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Not Abandoned
argue_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Sorrow speaks loudly, but listen.
Walk on. The road is not done.

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Not Pride
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] No one foresaw this morning.
Walk simply. Carry the grief.

stranger_joins.title: [TODO:es] A Quiet Traveler
stranger_joins.text:
[TODO:es] A stranger falls in step beside you.
"What are you discussing?" he asks.

refuse_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Welcome Him
refuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] A road shared is grief halved.
Speak. The stranger listens.

mock_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Not Mockery
mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] He has asked in kindness.
Answer him in kind.

share_grief.title: [TODO:es] Concerning Jesus
share_grief.text:
[TODO:es] "He was a prophet, mighty in word.
They crucified Him. We had hoped..."

choices.text: [TODO:es] Blame the women for the rumor
[TODO:es] Cut the story short in shame
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Tell it whole. He is listening.

blame_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Do Not Blame
blame_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] The women carried only what they saw.
Tell the story whole.

short_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Tell It All
short_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Hide nothing from this stranger.
He is more present than you know.

scripture.title: [TODO:es] Foolish and Slow
scripture.text:
[TODO:es] "Did the Christ not have to suffer
and so enter into His glory?"

offense_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Not Offense
offense_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] His sharpness is the surgeon's blade.
Receive it. It is healing you.

interrupt_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Be Still
interrupt_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] You do not yet see what he sees.
Let him finish. Then you will know.

burning_hearts.title: [TODO:es] Hearts Aflame
burning_hearts.text:
[TODO:es] Something kindles inside your chest.
You cannot name it, but it burns.

distrust_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Trust the Fire
distrust_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Your heart knows before your mind.
Let it lead you forward.

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Not Demand
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Heaven does not yield to demand.
Receive softly. Be carried.

invite_stay.title: [TODO:es] Emmaus Village
invite_stay.text:
El pueblo se acerca. Él hace como que va a seguir.
El sol se pone bajo.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] He turns and follows you in.

letgo_consequence.title: No le pierdas
letgo_consequence.text:
Algunos momentos deben ser retenidos.
Llámale. Ruégale que se quede.

charge_consequence.title: No por precio
charge_consequence.text:
Un huésped es bienvenido, no vendido.
Abre tu puerta libremente.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You set the table for three.

breaking_bread.title: Tomó el pan
breaking_bread.text:
Toma el pan. Lo bendice.
Lo parte. Te lo da.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Look at His hands. See Him.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] This is no time for pride.

look_consequence.title: Alza tus ojos
look_consequence.text:
No te pierdas esto por hambre.
El Huésped es el Señor.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Look at His hands. See Him.

host_consequence.title: No orgullo
host_consequence.text:
Tu pan se convirtió en Su bendición.
Mira. Recibe. Quédate quieto.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Look at His hands. See Him.

recognition.title: Desaparece
recognition.text:
¡Es el Señor! Tus ojos se abren.
Y luego Él se va.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Sit stunned and stay the night
[TODO:es] Rise at once. Run to Jerusalem

stay_consequence.title: No esperes
stay_consequence.text:
La noche no es un obstáculo ahora.
Ve. Los once deben oír.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Rise at once. Run to Jerusalem

whisper_consequence.title: Díselo a todos
whisper_consequence.text:
Esto no es un secreto que guardar.
¡Que la ciudad oiga: «¡Vive!»

choices.text: [TODO:es] Rise at once. Run to Jerusalem
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You set out into the dusk.

ending.title: Ha resucitado de verdad
ending.text:
Irrumpes: «¡El Señor ha resucitado!
Partió el pan con nosotros esta noche».
